_comment: UX budgets checked by tests/ux/ux-audit.mjs on every CI run. Numbers are ceilings: lower them as screens improve, never raise them without a reason in the commit message. cls = layout shift after a tab's data has loaded (reading time); clsLoad = shift while it loads (skeleton to content). answerMs = time from tab tap to the tab's one-line answer showing data (TabHeadline or the Crypto Desk brief); answerExempt = tabs named here have no answer line yet (each needs a reason); any other tab with no answer within 10 s fails the run.
